function.arguments:
{"code": "
import openpyxl
from copy import copy
import os

# ============================================================
# Step 1: Load source workbook and copy all sheets to summary.xlsx
# ============================================================
src_path = './materials/FinancialStatementFY26Q4.xlsx'
dst_path = './summary.xlsx'

src_wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(src_path)
dst_wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
# Remove default sheet
dst_wb.remove(dst_wb.active)

# Copy all sheets
for sheet_name in src_wb.sheetnames:
    src_ws = src_wb[sheet_name]
    dst_ws = dst_wb.create_sheet(title=sheet_name)
    
    for row in src_ws.iter_rows(min_row=1, max_row=src_ws.max_row, max_col=src_ws.max_column):
        for cell in row:
            new_cell = dst_ws.cell(row=cell.row, column=cell.column, value=cell.value)
            # Copy formatting
            if cell.has_style:
                new_cell.font = copy(cell.font)
                new_cell.border = copy(cell.border)
                new_cell.fill = copy(cell.fill)
                new_cell.number_format = cell.number_format
                new_cell.protection = copy(cell.protection)
                new_cell.alignment = copy(cell.alignment)
    
    # Copy merged cells
    for merged_range in src_ws.merged_cells.ranges:
        dst_ws.merge_cells(str(merged_range))

# ============================================================
# Step 2: Create Summary sheet with formulas referencing Segment Results
# ============================================================
summary_ws = dst_wb.create_sheet(title='Summary')

# Layout:
# Row 1: Title
# Row 2: blank
# Row 3: Header - Segment | Revenue | Operating Profit | Operating Margin
# Row 4-6: Data for 3 segments
# Row 7: Total row

# Headers
summary_ws['A1'] = 'Microsoft FY26 Q4 Segment Summary'
summary_ws['A3'] = 'Segment'
summary_ws['B3'] = 'Revenue ($M)'
summary_ws['C3'] = 'Operating Profit ($M)'
summary_ws['D3'] = 'Operating Margin'

# Style headers
for col in ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D']:
    cell = summary_ws[f'{col}3']
    cell.font = openpyxl.styles.Font(bold=True)

# Segment data rows with formulas referencing Segment Results sheet
# Segment Results layout:
# A9: Productivity and Business Processes header
# A10: Revenue, B10: 37847 (Three Months Ended June 30, 2026)
# A13: Operating income, B13: 21900
# A14: Intelligent Cloud header
# A15: Revenue, B15: 39306
# A18: Operating income, B18: 15955
# A19: More Personal Computing header
# A20: Revenue, B20: 12854
# A23: Operating income, B23: 2748

segments = [
    ('Productivity and Business Processes', 10, 13),  # Revenue row, Operating income row
    ('Intelligent Cloud', 15, 18),
    ('More Personal Computing', 20, 23),
]

for i, (seg_name, rev_row, op_row) in enumerate(segments):
    row = 4 + i
    summary_ws[f'A{row}'] = seg_name
    # Revenue formula
    summary_ws[f'B{row}'] = f"='Segment Results'!B{rev_row}"
    # Operating Profit formula
    summary_ws[f'C{row}'] = f"='Segment Results'!B{op_row}"
    # Operating Margin formula = Operating Profit / Revenue
    summary_ws[f'D{row}'] = f"=C{row}/B{row}"
    # Format margin as percentage
    summary_ws[f'D{row}'].number_format = '0.00%'

# Total row (row 7)
total_row = 7
summary_ws[f'A{total_row}'] = 'Total'
summary_ws[f'A{total_row}'].font = openpyxl.styles.Font(bold=True)
# Sum of revenues
summary_ws[f'B{total_row}'] = f'=SUM(B4:B6)'
# Sum of operating profits
summary_ws[f'C{total_row}'] = f'=SUM(C4:C6)'
# Operating margin = total operating profit / total revenue
summary_ws[f'D{total_row}'] = f'=C{total_row}/B{total_row}'
summary_ws[f'D{total_row}'].number_format = '0.00%'

# Bold the total row
for col in ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D']:
    summary_ws[f'{col}{total_row}'].font = openpyxl.styles.Font(bold=True)

# Save
dst_wb.save(dst_path)
print(f"Saved to {dst_path}")
print(f"File size: {os.path.getsize(dst_path)} bytes")
"}
